historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct Type 41 selection but incomplete records and no PCI/device correlation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly separates metadata persistence from NIC link/function testing and protects management reachability.

historical_reviews.v3_1: The instance number and segment:BDF jointly disambiguate same-type LAN devices; descriptions alone are insufficient, and management NIC identity must be recorded before reboot.

original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 41 onboard LAN device's extended identity and PCI location against the board topology and across reboot.
original_method: Capture all complete Type 41 records, map by designation/type/instance and segment:BDF, cross-check read-only OS PCI identity, record which interface carries management, reboot under approval with independent recovery, then repeat and diff.
manual_activity: Owner supplies the onboard-LAN/PCI map and approves reboot/network-impact handling; operator maintains independent OOB recovery.
safety_requirements: Do not suppress errors or bypass host/TLS identity
Do not join by description alone
Validate management path and independent recovery
Stop on lost management or mapping change
Do not claim functional link or hardware PASS
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete Type 41 plus read-only PCI inventory
Report metadata-only scope without final verdict
engineer_actions: Supply board/LAN map and management ownership

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 41` matches the source, but the long heading grep is fragile and cannot capture six fields or multiple LAN devices; unsafe SSH and hidden errors invalidate it.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture every complete Type 41 record and read-only PCI identity before and after an approved reboot, map by designation/instance/BDF and preserve management recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All six named fields, LAN scope, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a Type 41 inventory keyed by designation, device type/instance and canonical PCI segment:BDF, correlated with immutable PCI vendor/device identity and management ownership.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete multi-device and management-aware correlation instead of a heading snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing/duplicate LAN instances, swapped BDFs and metadata drift while avoiding false claims about link operation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS PCI visibility corroborates identity but does not prove network function; link and traffic coverage remain separate.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define the expected onboard LAN population, BDF map and management ownership. Type 10 evidence cannot replace this Type 41 extended mapping.
expected_evidence: Expected LAN/PCI map and management ownership
No link-function or hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure, command and script consistently target Type 41 onboard LAN records.

blocked_analysis.analysis: LAN topology, tools and reboot/recovery inputs are finite; absence delays execution rather than review.

review_improvement: Prevents one truncated Type 41 record or description-only match from passing the full onboard-LAN PCI mapping or jeopardizing management recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 41 adds instance and PCI location semantics needed to distinguish same-type onboard LAN devices. Because one may carry management traffic, identity and recovery must precede reboot. The read is automatable, but reboot/network impact makes REQUIRES correct.
